payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP table dp[i][j] stores max score for substrings ending at i and j, using Smith-Waterman style recurrence with match=+2, mismatch=-1, restart at 0.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a nested loop over positions in A and B, building a 2D DP array. State transitions from (i-1,j), (i,j-1), (i-1,j-1) are typical of 2D DP for two sequences, not 1D.
